title: The Best of National Parks of Thailand — Doi Inthanon
publisher: Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (Thailand)
claims: The Department of National Parks describes Doi Inthanon as Thailand's highest peak at 2,565 m above mean sea level.
The same document describes the mountain as blanketed with moisture and subject to cool weather, with hill evergreen forest around the summit enshrouded in mist and cool air all year round.
